name: ai-visibility-check
description: Audit how AI assistants and search engines find, understand and recommend a website, and get a prioritised action plan.

interface.longDescription:
AI Visibility Check is a website audit tool. It measures how well a website can be found, read and recommended by AI assistants and by search engines, and turns the result into a prioritised list of fixes.

Ask for a quick audit and it checks the homepage in about a minute: crawler access and robots.txt, structured data, on-page content, trust signals and technical health. Ask for a full audit and it also crawls the whole site, renders it in a real browser, checks outside sources, measures page speed, and asks AI models real questions to see whether they recognise the business, recommend it, and which competitors they name instead.

Then ask about the result in plain language: the score and headline, the issues by severity or by section with their evidence, an action plan in order with the effort and score gain of each fix, and how AI assistants see the brand. Every finding carries its evidence, and anything that could not be measured is reported as unmeasured, never as a failure.

Built for business owners, marketers, agencies and developers who want to know whether their site is visible in AI answers and what to fix first. It reads public web pages only and never changes the site it audits. Requires an AI Visibility Check account, which you can create while connecting.
capabilities: Run quick and full website audits
Check whether AI assistants recommend a brand
See how many full audits are left
defaultPrompt: Run a quick AI visibility audit of my website.
What should I fix first on my site?
Do AI assistants recommend my business?

positive.prompt: Run a quick AI visibility audit of cyberspark.uk.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a quick audit, waits for it, and reports the score out of 100, the band, the headline, the top actions and a link to the full report on aivisibilitycheck.io. The tool returns no price or payment link.

positive.prompt: How many full audits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: States how many full audits the test account has left, which of them expire and when (if any), and when the next free one is added. The tool returns no price or payment link.

positive.description: Issues of an earlier audit, by severity
positive.prompt: What are the most important problems in my latest audit of aivisibilitycheck.io?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the existing audit of aivisibilitycheck.io in the test account and lists its issues, most important first, each with why it matters and the fix.

positive.prompt: What should I fix first on aivisibilitycheck.io, and how much would each fix raise the score?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the ordered action plan from the existing audit: each action, the problem it closes, its effort and its score gain, and the score after each fix.

positive.description: AI assistant visibility from a full audit
positive.prompt: Do AI assistants recommend Cyber Spark? Which competitors do they name instead?
positive.expected_behavior: From the existing full audit of cyberspark.uk, says whether AI models recognise the brand when asked directly, whether they name it unprompted, per model, and which competitors they name instead, noting that answers were sampled at one point in time.

negative.description: Purchase request: no tool sells anything or returns a price or checkout link; the user is pointed to their account on aivisibilitycheck.io
negative.prompt: Buy me ten more full audits.

negative.description: Destructive request: no tool deletes anything; the user is told they can delete their account and audits themselves in their account settings on aivisibilitycheck.io
negative.prompt: Delete all my audits and my account.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no audit tool should be called
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the sea.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything and processes no payments. It has no checkout, no prices and no purchase links.

publication.release_notes: First release: quick and full AI visibility audits, issues, action plan and AI assistant visibility.

de-DE.subtitle: KI-Sichtbarkeit prüfen
de-DE.description: AI Visibility Check ist ein Website-Audit-Tool. Es misst, wie gut KI-Assistenten und Suchmaschinen eine Website finden, verstehen und empfehlen, und macht daraus eine priorisierte Liste von Maßnahmen. Ein Schnell-Audit prüft die Startseite in etwa einer Minute; ein vollständiges Audit durchsucht die ganze Website, lädt sie in einem echten Browser, prüft externe Quellen und fragt KI-Modelle, ob sie das Unternehmen kennen und empfehlen. Danach fragen Sie in normaler Sprache nach Punktwert, Problemen mit Belegen, einem Maßnahmenplan in Reihenfolge und der Sichtbarkeit in KI-Assistenten. Erfordert ein AI-Visibility-Check-Konto, das Sie beim Verbinden anlegen können.
